title.en: How a Pinjin Concrete Pump Moves Concrete
title.zh: 品锦混凝土泵怎样输送混凝土

description.en: How a Pinjin Concrete Pump Moves Concrete
description.zh: 品锦混凝土泵怎样输送混凝土

h1.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery describes its Xingtai concrete pumps as pipeline machines. The sheets name hoppers and, on some rows, hydraulic pumps. The parts list names an S-valve, pistons and cylinder seals. Bore, stroke and strokes per minute are not printed.
h1.zh: 河北品锦机械把邢台混凝土泵写成管道机器。参数页写料斗，部分行写液压泵。配件目录写明S阀、活塞和油缸密封。缸径、行程和每分钟冲程没有印出。

directAnswer.en: A concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai moves concrete from a hopper into a delivery pipe. That is the path the catalogue describes. Some pump pages also name a hydraulic pump, such as a Kawasaki unit. The parts list names S-valve pistons, an S-tube seal, a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal. The sheets do not print cylinder bore, piston stroke or strokes per minute, so this note does not invent a timed cycle.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，把混凝土从料斗送进输送管。这是目录描述的路径。部分泵页还写出液压泵，例如川崎机组。配件目录写明S阀活塞、S管密封、主油缸密封和摆缸密封。参数页不印缸径、活塞行程或每分钟冲程，因此这里不编造一套带节拍的循环。

heading.en: The path that is actually named

body.en: Many concrete pump sheets print a hopper capacity. Pages that print a delivery-pipe diameter name that diameter only for themselves: Electric 20 prints 80 mm, Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm, and the integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. Pages without a pipe cell do not receive a borrowed diameter. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these machines in Xingtai. The concrete leaves through the pipe the page names, not through a truck placing boom.
body.zh: 许多混凝土泵页面印了料斗容积。印了输送管内径的页面，管径只属于自己：电动20为 80 mm，电动15为 100–125 mm，搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 为 100 / 125 mm。没有管径格的页面不能借用管径。河北品锦机械在邢台制造这些机器。混凝土从该页写出的管道离开，不是从车载布料杆离开。

heading.en: Assemblies named without a cycle diagram
heading.zh: 点了名称、但没有循环图的总成

body.en: The spare-parts category calls the wear range S-valve parts. The split-piston line says the set is for S-valve concrete pumps. Separate lines name an S-tube seal, a main-cylinder seal, a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. Those names tell you the vocabulary of the circuit. They do not publish bore, stroke, swing angle or a step order. A Kawasaki name on a pump row is the hydraulic-pump cell, not a displacement.
body.zh: 配件分类把易损件称为 S 阀配件。分体活塞一行写明用于 S 阀混凝土泵。另外的行写明 S 管密封、主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头。这些名称给出回路用词，并没有公布缸径、行程、摆角或步骤顺序。泵页上的川崎名称是液压泵格，不是排量。

body.en: Do not draw piston speed, cylinder diameter or strokes per minute for a Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pump. Those figures are absent. Do not turn the parts names into a replacement procedure. If a project needs a structural size the page does not print, ask through /en/contact/ and keep the blank cell blank.
body.zh: 不要为河北品锦机械的混凝土泵画活塞速度、缸径或每分钟冲程。这些数字没有公布。不要把配件名称写成更换步骤。如果项目需要页面没印的结构尺寸，请通过 /zh/contact/ 询问，空白格子保持空白。

question.en: Does the catalogue print piston stroke?

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print piston stroke, cylinder bore or strokes per minute on the Xingtai concrete pump sheets.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有在邢台混凝土泵参数页印出活塞行程、缸径或每分钟冲程。

question.en: Where does the concrete leave the machine?
question.zh: 混凝土从机器哪里离开？

answer.en: Through the delivery pipe named on that model page. If the page has no pipe diameter, do not borrow one from another concrete pump.
answer.zh: 通过该型号页写出的输送管。如果该页没有管径，不要向另一台混凝土泵借用。

question.en: What does a Kawasaki line mean?
question.zh: 川崎这一行是什么意思？

answer.en: It is the hydraulic-pump name printed on that concrete pump page. The cell does not add a displacement figure.
answer.zh: 它是该混凝土泵页面印出的液压泵名称。这一格没有附带排量。

question.en: Is there a published pumping-cycle diagram?
question.zh: 有没有公布的泵送循环图？

answer.en: No timed cycle is printed. The published path is hopper to delivery pipe, plus the assembly names on the parts list.
answer.zh: 没有印出带节拍的循环。已公布的路径是料斗到输送管，再加上配件清单上的总成名称。
